column2: AI-generated models carry the attribute Created with AI and the description used. The attribute stays until the model's first approval.
AI-generated content goes through the same approval workflow as any other model (Chapter 10). No exceptions for "drafts" in the published folders.
AI answers on process data are drafts. Numbers used in decisions come from metrics.
Prompts and uploads contain no personal data beyond what the pseudonymized data already shows, and no confidential documents outside the approved AI scope.
AI unit use is reported monthly by feature; features without measured benefit after three months are switched off.
